<style id="dca-global-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Dra. Célia Alcântara · Reumatologia
   CSS global do site (carregado pelo template de Cabeçalho do Elementor).
   Todas as classes começam com "dca-" para não colidir com tema/plugins.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --dca-bg: #fdfdfd;
  --dca-linen: #f7f4ef;
  --dca-sand: #efe8dc;
  --dca-navy: #1f3363;
  --dca-navy-deep: #16264a;
  --dca-navy-soft: #2a4379;
  --dca-teal: #3aa9c8;
  --dca-teal-ink: #1d7c97;
  --dca-teal-em: #2a93b1;
  --dca-teal-hover: #5ec0db;
  --dca-teal-light: #7fcde3;
  --dca-gold: #c29f5f;
  --dca-gold-deep: #a4813f;
  --dca-gold-ink: #8c6b31;
  --dca-gold-light: #dcc293;
  --dca-ink: #1f2536;
  --dca-text: #3a4053;
  --dca-muted: #596075;
  --dca-line: #e7e1d5;
  --dca-on-navy: #eef1f7;
  --dca-on-navy-muted: #b8c2d9;

  --dca-serif: "Playfair Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --dca-sans: "Poppins", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --dca-script: "Pinyon Script", "Playfair Display", cursive;

  --dca-ease: cubic-bezier(.23, 1, .32, 1);
  --dca-ease-io: cubic-bezier(.77, 0, .175, 1);
  --dca-radius: 22px;
  --dca-shadow: 0 30px 60px -36px rgba(31, 51, 99, .35);
}

/* ---------- Base ---------- */
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 110px; }
body {
  background: var(--dca-bg);
  color: var(--dca-text);
  font-family: var(--dca-sans);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
::selection { background: #cdebf3; color: var(--dca-navy-deep); }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dca-teal); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
html { scrollbar-color: var(--dca-teal) var(--dca-bg); }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--dca-bg); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--dca-sand); border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--dca-bg); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--dca-teal); }

.dca-sr {
  position: absolute !important; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}
.dca-skip {
  position: fixed; left: 16px; top: -60px; z-index: 10000; padding: 12px 18px;
  background: var(--dca-navy); color: #fff !important; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 .875rem var(--dca-sans);
  transition: top .25s var(--dca-ease);
}
.dca-skip:focus { top: 16px; }

/* ---------- Tipografia ---------- */
.elementor .dca-display .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor .dca-h2 .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor .dca-h3 .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor .dca-h1-post .elementor-heading-title {
  font-family: var(--dca-serif);
  color: var(--dca-navy);
  font-weight: 400;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.elementor .dca-display .elementor-heading-title {
  font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.5rem + 4vw, 4.9rem);
  line-height: 1.04;
  letter-spacing: -.025em;
}
.elementor .dca-display--md .elementor-heading-title { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 1.6rem + 3.2vw, 4.25rem); }
.elementor .dca-h2 .elementor-heading-title {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.35rem + 2.2vw, 3.1rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.018em;
}
.elementor .dca-h2--sm .elementor-heading-title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 1.3rem + 1.4vw, 2.35rem); }
.elementor .dca-h3 .elementor-heading-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 1.1rem + .6vw, 1.6rem);
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.elementor .dca-h1-post .elementor-heading-title {
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 1.4rem + 2.8vw, 3.6rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}
.elementor .elementor-heading-title em,
.dca-serif-em em {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--dca-teal-em);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.dca-h1-tail {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .9rem;
  font-family: var(--dca-sans);
  font-size: clamp(.95rem, .9rem + .25vw, 1.0625rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--dca-muted);
}

.elementor .dca-lead,
.elementor .dca-prose,
.elementor .dca-small {
  font-family: var(--dca-sans);
  color: var(--dca-text);
}
.elementor .dca-lead {
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1rem + .3vw, 1.2rem);
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--dca-muted);
  max-width: 46ch;
}
.elementor .dca-lead p,
.elementor .dca-prose p { margin: 0 0 1.1em; }
.elementor .dca-lead p:last-child,
.elementor .dca-prose p:last-child,
.elementor .dca-prose ul:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.elementor .dca-prose {
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
  max-width: 68ch;
}
.elementor .dca-prose strong { font-weight: 500; color: var(--dca-navy); }
.elementor .dca-prose a,
.dca-inline-link {
  color: var(--dca-teal-ink);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: .22em;
  transition: color .2s ease, text-decoration-color .2s ease;
}
.elementor .dca-prose a:hover { color: var(--dca-navy); text-decoration-color: var(--dca-teal); }
.elementor .dca-prose ul,
.dca-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0 0 1.3em;
  padding: 0;
}
.elementor .dca-prose ul li,
.dca-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.7em;
  margin: 0 0 .75em;
}
.elementor .dca-prose ul li::before,
.dca-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: .9em;
  width: .95em;
  height: 1.5px;
  background: var(--dca-teal);
}
.elementor .dca-small { font-size: .8125rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--dca-muted); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.elementor .dca-measure { max-width: 60ch; }
.elementor .dca-center,
.elementor .dca-center .elementor-heading-title { text-align: center; margin-inline: auto; }

/* Texto sobre o azul-marinho */
.dca-dark { color: var(--dca-on-navy); }
.elementor .dca-dark .elementor-heading-title { color: #fff; }
.elementor .dca-dark .elementor-heading-title em { color: var(--dca-teal); }
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-lead,
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-small { color: var(--dca-on-navy-muted); }
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-prose { color: var(--dca-on-navy); }
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-prose strong { color: #fff; }
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-prose ul li::before { background: var(--dca-teal); }

/* ---------- Botões ---------- */
.elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button {
  font-family: var(--dca-sans);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: .9375rem;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 1.1em 1.9em;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background-color: var(--dca-teal);
  color: var(--dca-navy-deep);
  fill: var(--dca-navy-deep);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -16px rgba(22, 38, 74, .4);
  transition: background-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, transform .16s var(--dca-ease), color .3s ease;
}
.elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button-content-wrapper { gap: .65em; align-items: center; }
.elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button-icon { font-size: 1.15em; margin: 0; }
.elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button-icon svg { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; fill: currentColor; }
.elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.elementor .dca-btn--gold .elementor-button { box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); }
.elementor .dca-btn--ghost .elementor-button { background-color: transparent; color: var(--dca-navy); fill: var(--dca-navy); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(31, 51, 99, .28); }
.elementor .dca-btn--ghost-light .elementor-button { background-color: transparent; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .35); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .elementor .dca-btn .elementor-button:hover { background-color: var(--dca-teal-hover); color: var(--dca-navy-deep); box-shadow: 0 20px 34px -18px rgba(22, 38, 74, .45); }
  .elementor .dca-btn--ghost .elementor-button:hover { background-color: transparent; color: var(--dca-navy); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--dca-teal); }
  .elementor .dca-btn--ghost-light .elementor-button:hover { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #fff; }
}

/* Link de texto com sublinhado que recolhe */
.dca-link {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55em;
  font: 500 .9375rem/1.4 var(--dca-sans);
  color: var(--dca-navy) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  padding-bottom: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(var(--dca-teal), var(--dca-teal)) 0 100% / 100% 1.5px no-repeat;
  transition: background-size .45s var(--dca-ease);
}
.dca-link svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; color: var(--dca-teal-ink); transition: transform .35s var(--dca-ease); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .dca-link:hover { background-size: 0 1.5px; background-position: 100% 100%; }
  .dca-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }
}
.dca-dark .dca-link { color: #fff !important; }

/* ---------- Assinatura visual: a "articulação" (linha + nó) ---------- */
.dca-joint {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  width: min(240px, 70%);
  color: var(--dca-teal);
}
.dca-joint--center { margin-inline: auto; width: 240px; max-width: 70vw; }
.elementor .dca-joint-w { width: 100%; }
.dca-joint--short { width: 120px; }
.dca-joint__line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform-origin: right center; }
.dca-joint__line + .dca-joint__node + .dca-joint__line { transform-origin: left center; }
.dca-joint__node {
  width: 11px; height: 11px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--dca-gold);
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--dca-gold) 0 2px, transparent 2.5px);
}
.dca-js .dca-joint .dca-joint__line { transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 1.2s var(--dca-ease-io) .15s; }
.dca-js .dca-joint .dca-joint__node { transform: scale(.3); opacity: 0; transition: transform .7s var(--dca-ease), opacity .5s ease; }
.dca-js .dca-joint.is-in .dca-joint__line { transform: scaleX(1); }
.dca-js .dca-joint.is-in .dca-joint__node { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }

/* ---------- Movimento: revelação ao rolar ---------- */
.dca-js .dca-reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 24px, 0);
  filter: blur(6px);
  transition:
    opacity .9s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms),
    transform 1.1s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms),
    filter .9s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms);
}
.dca-js .dca-reveal.is-in { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }

/* Imagens: cortina que sobe + leve zoom de assentamento */
.dca-js .dca-img-reveal img {
  clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0);
  transform: scale(1.08);
  transition: clip-path 1.4s var(--dca-ease-io), transform 1.8s var(--dca-ease);
}
.dca-js .dca-img-reveal.is-in img { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: none; }

/* Título do topo: entrada orquestrada ao carregar */
.dca-js .dca-load { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 28px, 0); filter: blur(8px); }
.dca-js.dca-ready .dca-load {
  opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none;
  transition: opacity 1s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms), transform 1.2s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms), filter 1s var(--dca-ease) var(--d, 0ms);
}

.elementor-editor-active .dca-reveal,
.elementor-editor-active .dca-load,
.elementor-editor-active .dca-img-reveal img,
.elementor-editor-active .dca-joint * { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; filter: none !important; clip-path: none !important; }

/* ---------- Imagens ---------- */
.elementor .dca-arch { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.elementor .dca-arch img {
  display: block; width: 100%; height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 50% 50% 28px 28px / 40% 40% 28px 28px;
  background: var(--dca-sand);
}
.elementor .dca-arch::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1;
  inset: 22px -22px -22px 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--dca-gold);
  border-radius: 50% 50% 32px 32px / 40% 40% 32px 32px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dca-js .elementor .dca-arch::after { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); transition: clip-path 1.8s var(--dca-ease-io) .5s; }
.dca-js .elementor .dca-arch.is-in::after { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); }
.elementor .dca-dark .dca-arch::after { border-color: var(--dca-gold-light); }

.elementor .dca-rounded img {
  display: block; width: 100%; height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: var(--ratio, 5 / 4); object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 28px; background: var(--dca-sand);
}
.elementor .dca-rounded--tall { --ratio: 4 / 5; }
.elementor .dca-rounded--wide { --ratio: 16 / 9; }
.elementor .dca-circle img {
  display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 420px; height: auto; margin-inline: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--dca-sand);
}
.elementor .dca-circle { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.elementor .dca-circle::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: 50%; top: 50%;
  width: min(116%, 488px); aspect-ratio: 1; translate: -50% -50%;
  border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--dca-gold);
}
.dca-js .elementor .dca-circle::before { opacity: 0; scale: .9; transition: opacity 1s ease .3s, scale 1.6s var(--dca-ease) .3s; }
.dca-js .elementor .dca-circle.is-in::before { opacity: 1; scale: 1; }
.dca-caption { font: 400 .8125rem/1.5 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-muted); margin-top: .75rem; }

/* ---------- Topo (hero) ---------- */
.elementor .dca-clip,
.elementor .dca-sec { overflow-x: clip; }
.elementor .dca-sticky { position: sticky; top: 120px; align-self: flex-start; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .elementor .dca-sticky { position: relative; top: 0; } }
@media (max-width: 767px) { .elementor .dca-arch::after { inset: 12px -10px -12px 10px; } .dca-band-facts { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .dca-credential .dca-dot { display: none; } }
.elementor .dca-hero-media { position: relative; }
.elementor .dca-hero-media::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 0;
  right: -12vw; top: 12%; bottom: -8%; width: 78%;
  background: var(--dca-linen);
  border-radius: 40px 0 0 40px;
}
.elementor .dca-hero-media > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.dca-credential {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 18px;
  font: 400 .8125rem/1.5 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-muted); letter-spacing: .02em;
}
.dca-credential b { font-weight: 500; color: var(--dca-navy); }
.dca-credential .dca-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dca-teal); }

.dca-float-card {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  width: max-content; max-width: 290px;
  padding: 14px 18px 14px 14px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--dca-line);
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--dca-shadow);
  font: 400 .8125rem/1.45 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-muted);
}
.dca-float-card strong { display: block; font: 500 .875rem/1.35 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-navy); }
.dca-float-card__icon {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dca-linen); color: var(--dca-teal-ink);
}
.dca-float-card__icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.elementor .dca-float { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: -36px; bottom: 9%; width: auto; }
@media (max-width: 767px) { .elementor .dca-float { left: 12px; bottom: -22px; } }

/* Breadcrumb */
.dca-crumbs ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; font: 400 .8125rem/1.5 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-muted); }
.dca-crumbs li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.dca-crumbs li + li::before { content: ""; width: 14px; height: 1px; background: var(--dca-teal); }
.dca-crumbs a { color: var(--dca-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s ease; }
.dca-crumbs a:hover { color: var(--dca-navy); }
.dca-crumbs [aria-current] { color: var(--dca-navy); font-weight: 500; }

/* ---------- Faixa de atendimento ---------- */
.dca-band-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px 28px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.dca-band-facts li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 400 .9375rem/1.45 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-on-navy); }
.dca-band-facts svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--dca-teal); flex: none; }
.dca-band-facts small { display: block; color: var(--dca-on-navy-muted); font-size: .8125rem; }

/* ---------- Palavras-chave em linha (o que é reumatologia) ---------- */
.dca-structures { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 18px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.dca-structures li { font: italic 400 clamp(1.15rem, 1rem + .6vw, 1.45rem)/1.4 var(--dca-serif); color: var(--dca-navy); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
.dca-structures li + li::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dca-teal); }

/* ---------- Índice de especialidades ---------- */
.dca-index { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dca-line); }
.dca-index li { border-top: 1px solid var(--dca-line); position: relative; }
.dca-index a {
  position: relative;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px 40px;
  padding: 30px 6px;
  text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
}
.dca-index a::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 1px;
  background: var(--dca-teal); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform .7s var(--dca-ease);
}
.dca-index h3 {
  margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(1.45rem, 1.15rem + 1vw, 2rem)/1.15 var(--dca-serif); color: var(--dca-navy);
  transition: transform .5s var(--dca-ease), color .3s ease;
}
.dca-index p { margin: 0; font: 400 .9375rem/1.65 var(--dca-sans); color: var(--dca-muted); }
.dca-arrow {
  width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--dca-line); color: var(--dca-navy);
  transition: background-color .4s var(--dca-ease), border-color .4s ease, color .3s ease, transform .5s var(--dca-ease);
}
.dca-arrow svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transform: rotate(-45deg); transition: transform .5s var(--dca-ease); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .dca-index a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .dca-index a:hover h3 { transform: translateX(10px); }
  .dca-index a:hover h3 em, .dca-index a:hover h3 { color: var(--dca-navy-soft); }
  .dca-index a:hover .dca-arrow { background: var(--dca-teal); border-color: var(--dca-teal); color: var(--dca-navy-deep); }
  .dca-index a:hover .dca-arrow svg { transform: rotate(0); }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .dca-index a { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; padding: 24px 2px; }
  .dca-index p { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; }
  .dca-arrow { width: 42px; height: 42px; grid-row: 1; grid-column: 2; }
}

/* ---------- Cartões que viram (Como vou ajudar você) ---------- */
.dca-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.dca-flip { perspective: 1400px; min-height: 330px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--dca-radius); }

  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 4px; right: -7px;

  .dca-timeline li::before, .dca-timeline li:nth-child(even)::before { left: 0; right: auto; }
}

/* ---------- Depoimentos e mídia (espaços reservados) ---------- */
